svg.title: Sheet 2 - External verifier
svg.text: SHEET 2 OF 3 - EXTERNAL VERIFIER (ESP32 + ATM90E26 reference)
(Sheet 1 meter, or a real prepaid meter)
meter and reference see the same current and the same supply
Burden, divider and input range come from the ATM90E26 module
documentation. Check the V and I input limits before connecting.
- The ESP32 and the ATM90E26 logic side never connect to mains directly.
- Voltage comes through VT1 and current through CT1: both isolate mains.
- Never open-circuit a CT secondary while its primary carries current.
- Use a fused, protected test arrangement and a qualified supervisor.
- Mains wiring in an insulated enclosure; check ratings of every part.
- Run the simulation / low-voltage tests first; test mains last.
1. ESP_RX is the 3.3 V output of the R8 / R9 divider on Sheet 1 (meter TX1, D18).
2. Firmware: 02_Verifier_ESP32_ATM90E26.ino. Set USE_SIM_REFERENCE 0 to read the ATM90E26.
3. The ATM90E26 must be configured and calibrated against a reference instrument
before its readings are used as the reference. Register map and SPI mode: verify.
4. Compare window energy: U% = (E_ref - E_meter) / E_ref x 100 (positive = under-registration).
5. LEDs: green normal, yellow suspect (1 window over tolerance), red alert (persistent).
6. Set the meter's TIME_ACCEL to 1.0 for physical tests (reference runs in real time).
7. Simulation (Proteus) cannot include the ESP32 / ATM90E26: test them on real hardware
or with USE_SIM_REFERENCE 1 fed by the meter's serial frames.
Rev 1.0 14 Oct 2026 Hardware not built or tested
